titleEn: The Glory of Kings — Azariah's Dream and the Taking of Zion (ch. 46–48)
part: ch. 46–48 — Azariah's Dream and the Taking of Zion
about: Azariah dreams that an angel bids him sacrifice for Zion and take the Ark when the sacrifice is offered; David (Menelik) asks his father for leave to sacrifice, Solomon supplies the offerings, and Azariah sacrifices too. Then the angel appears again, the Temple gates are found open, and the four young men lift the Ark and set the wooden copy in its place.

sentences.t: ፵፮ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ መከሩ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ጽዮን ።
sentences.l: 46. How they-took-counsel concerning Zion.
sentences.i: Chapter 46: How they took counsel concerning Zion.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ዘከመ 'how, in what manner' introduces a clause; መከሩ is the 3rd masc. plural perfect of መከረ 'take counsel'. በእንተ 'concerning'. ጽዮን Zion, here the Ark, as throughout the book.

sentences.t: ወእንዘ ፡ ይነውም ፡ በሌሊት ፡ አስተርአዮ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለአዛርያስ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ንሣእ ፡ ለከ ፡ ፬ ፡ ጠሊተ ፡ ዘዘዓመት ፡ ዘበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአትክሙ ፡ ወለከ ፡ ወለኤልምያስ ፡ ወለአቢስ ፡ ወለማክሪ ፡ ወአርባዕተ ፡ በግዐ ፡ ንጹሐ ፡ ዘዘዓመት ፡ ወአሐተ ፡ ላህመ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢሰሐበት ፡ አርዑተ ፡ ወትሠውዓ ፡ እምሥራቃ ፡ ወአባግዐኒወአጣሌ ፡ በየማና ፡ ወበፀጋማ ፡ ወበዐረቢሃ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሙፃኣ ፤
sentences.l: And-while he-sleeps by-night appeared-to-him angel-of God to-Azariah, and-he-said-to-him: Take for-you 4 lambs (?) of-each-year, which for-sake-of your-sin, and-for-you and-for-Elmeyas and-for-Abis and-for-Makri, and-four sheep pure of-each-year, and-one cow which not she-drew yokes, and-you-sacrifice-her from-her-east, and-the-sheep-also and-the-kids on-her-right and-on-her-left and-on-her-west, which where her-exit (?);
sentences.i: While he was asleep by night, the angel of God appeared to Azariah and said to him: "Take for yourself four year-old lambs (?), for the sin of you all, for yourself and for Elmeyas, Abis and Makri, and four pure sheep, each a year old, and one cow that has never drawn the yoke. Sacrifice it on the east side of it, and the sheep and the kids on its right and its left and its west, on the side where its exit is (?);
sentences.n: ወእንዘ ይነውም 'and while he sleeps' (እንዘ + imperfect = a circumstantial clause); አስተርአዮ 'appeared to him' (አስተርአየ, the Ct-stem (አስተ-) 'show oneself, appear'). መልአከ እግዚኣብሔር 'angel-of God', a construct chain, the construct state, ending in -ä. ንሣእ 'take!' (imperative of ነሥአ). ጠሊተ: ጠሊ is a young animal, 'lamb or kid' (?), the ending -ተ I cannot place (?) ዘዘዓመት 'of each year', 'year-old'. ኀጢአትክሙ 'your (pl.) sin' (the -ክሙ is plural, so the sin is that of all the men addressed). After ለከ (Azariah himself) come his three companions Elmeyas, Abis and Makri (ch. 48 spells them Elmeyanos, Abisa, Makari). ላህመ እንተ ኢሰሐበት አርዑተ 'a cow that has not drawn yokes' (the unyoked beast of Numbers 19:2, a red heifer, though no colour is given). ወትሠውዓ 'and you shall sacrifice it' (3rd fem. object suffix, 'her'). Source oddity: አባግዐኒወአጣሌ has lost its word-spaces, so ኒ (also) and ወ- run into አጣሌ; I read 'the sheep also, and the kids'. እምሥራቃ 'from its east'; በፀጋማ 'on its left' (ፀጋም); በዐረቢሃ 'on its west' (?). The final clause እንተ ኀበ ሙፃኣ 'which (is) where its exit (is)' is obscure to me (?); ሙፃኣ looks like a noun of 'going out' from ወፅአ with -ኣ 'her' (?); I cannot confirm the form.

sentences.t: ወይንግሮ ፡ እግዚእክሙ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወይበሎ ፡ አሐተ ፡ እስእል ፡ በኀቤከ ፡ ኦአባ ፡ ከመ ፡ እሡዕ ፡ ለቅድስት ፡ ሀገር ፡ ኢየሩሳሌም ፡ ወለእግዝእትየ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ቅድስት ፡ ሰማያዊት ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-he-will-tell-him your-lord David to-Solomon, king, and-he-will-say-to-him: One I-ask of-you, O-father, that I-sacrifice for-the-holy city Jerusalem and-for-my-lady Zion, holy, heavenly, ark-of his-law of-God;
sentences.i: Then your lord David will tell King Solomon and will say to him: 'One thing I ask of you, father: that I may sacrifice for the holy city Jerusalem and for my lady Zion, the holy, heavenly Ark of the law of God.'
sentences.n: ወይንግሮ 'and he will tell him' (the imperfect with ወ- is future here). እግዚእክሙ 'your lord': David is the young prince, Menelik, whom the priests' sons call 'our lord'. ኦአባ 'O father' (ኦ vocative, glued to the noun). ከመ እሡዕ 'that I sacrifice' (ከመ + subjunctive of ሠውዐ). ለቅድስት ሀገር ኢየሩሳሌም 'for the holy city Jerusalem' (the ለ- marks the thing sacrificed for). ጽዮን is addressed as 'my lady' (እግዝእትየ), and ታቦተ ሕጉ ለእግዚኣብሔር 'the ark of his law, of God' stands in apposition; ሕጉ is ሕግ + ሁ 'his law'. ሰማያዊት 'heavenly', the ቅድስት ሰማያዊት, compare Hebrews 9:23 and Revelation 11:19 (heavenly sanctuary, heavenly ark).

sentences.t: ወይቤሎግበር ፤
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him: do;
sentences.i: and he will say to him: 'Do so';
sentences.n: Source oddity: ወይቤሎግበር has lost the wordspace after ወይቤሎ 'and he will say to him'. ግበር 'do!' (imperative of ገብረ). Solomon is the speaker. ወይቤሎ is the perfect ይቤሎ (the same form as in the first unit, 'he said to him'); inside the angel's prediction I give it a future sense, reading the perfect as narrative sequence within the prophecy (?).

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ይበሎ ፡ ይሡዕ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ካህን ፡ በከመ ፡ ያአምር ፡ ወይኤዝዘከ ፡ ለከ ፡ ወአንተ ፡ ትሠውዕ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-will-say-to-him: Let-sacrifice for-me son-of priest, as he-knows, and-he-will-command-you to-you, and-you you-sacrifice;
sentences.i: And again he will say to him: 'Let a priest's son sacrifice for me, as he knows how'; and Solomon will give you your orders, and you shall do the sacrificing;
sentences.n: ወካዕበ 'and again'. ይሡዕ is a jussive 'let him sacrifice'. ወልደ ካህን 'son-of priest', i.e. Azariah, son of Zadok. በከመ ያአምር 'according as he knows'. ወይኤዝዘከ 'and he will command you' (አዘዘ with the suffix -ከ). The word ለከ after it is awkward (?); I take it as a dative 'to you'. ወአንተ ትሠውዕ 'and you, you will sacrifice', the pronoun adds emphasis.

sentences.t: ወታወፅኣ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ሦዕከ ፡ ወካዕበ ፡ ኣስተርእየከ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ ትገብር ፡ ላቲ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ታወፅኣ ፡ እስመ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ኮነት ፡ ዛቲ ፤
sentences.l: And-you-bring-her-out, the-ark-of his-law of-God, after you-sacrificed; and-again I-will-show-you how you-do to-her while you-bring-her-out, for from-with God it-came this;
sentences.i: and you shall bring the Ark of the law of God out, after you have sacrificed; and I will again show you what to do with her as you bring her out, for this came from God;
sentences.n: ታወፅኣ 'you will bring her out' (አውፅአ, the causative of ወፅአ 'go out', plus the 3rd fem. suffix -ኣ; the object ታቦተ has the ለ- accusative marker, ለታቦተ). ሦዕከ 'you sacrificed' (2nd masc. sing. perfect of ሠውዐ, contracted; so እምድኅረ ሦዕከ 'after you have sacrificed'). ኣስተርእየከ 'I will show you' (አስተርአየ again, 1st sing.); the spelling with ኣ for አ recurs in this part and is Bezold's. ዘከመ ትገብር ላቲ 'how you will act toward her'. እንዘ ታወፅኣ 'while you bring her out'. እምኀበ እግዚኣብሔር 'from (the place of) God'. ኮነት ዛቲ 'this (fem.) came about'.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አምዕዕዎ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወበእንተዝ ፡ ያፈልሳ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ እምኔሆሙ ፨
sentences.l: for they-provoked-him Israel, God, and-therefore he-will-remove-her, the-ark-of his-law of-God, from-them.
sentences.i: for Israel have provoked God, and for that reason he will remove the Ark of the law of God from them."
sentences.n: አምዕዕዎ 'they have provoked him to anger' (3rd masc. plural perfect + -ዎ 'him', the object doubled by ለእግዚኣብሔር; Israel is the collective subject) (አምዕዐ, causative; the sense 'embitter, provoke' is my reading (?)). ወበእንተዝ 'and because of this'. ያፈልሳ 'he will remove her' (አፈለሰ, causative of ፈለሰ 'migrate, go into exile'; the theme of the Ark's migration). እምኔሆሙ 'from them'. Ends with ፨, the paragraph-sign, then the speech of the angel is over.

sentences.t: ወሶበ ፡ ነቅሀ ፡ እምንዋሙ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ተፈሥሐ ፡ ፈድፋደ ፡ ወበርሀ ፡ ልቡ ፡ ወኅሊናሁ ፡ ወተዘከረ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘአስተርአዮ ፡ በሌሊት ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ዐተቦ ፡ ወአጽንዖ ፡ ወአለበዎ ።
sentences.l: And-when he-awoke from-his-sleep Azariah, he-rejoiced exceedingly, and-it-shone his-heart and-his-mind, and-he-remembered all which appeared-to-him by-night angel-of God, and-how he-marked-him (?) and-strengthened-him and-gave-him-understanding (?).
sentences.i: When Azariah woke from his sleep he rejoiced greatly, his heart and mind grew bright, and he remembered all that the angel of God had shown him in the night, and how he had marked him (?), strengthened him and enlightened him.
sentences.n: ወሶበ ነቅሀ 'and when he awoke' (ሶበ 'when', then the perfect of ነቅሀ). እምንዋሙ 'from his sleep', ንዋሙ is ንዋም 'sleep' + -ሁ 'his'. ተፈሥሐ ፈድፋደ 'he rejoiced exceedingly'. ወበርሀ ልቡ ወኅሊናሁ 'and his heart and his mind shone'. ወተዘከረ 'and he remembered' (ተዘከረ). ዘአስተርአዮ 'what appeared to him' (relative ዘ). The last three verbs are each 'he __-ed him' with the suffix -ሁ: ዐተቦ (ዐተበ is 'to mark, give a sign' (?); how that fits here I do not know); ወአጽንዖ (አጽንዐ 'strengthened'); ወአለበዎ (አለበወ 'gave him understanding' (?), from ልብ 'heart, mind').

sentences.t: ወሖረ ፡ ኀበ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ አኀዊሁ ፡ ወተጋብኡ ፡ አሐተኔ ፡ ወነገሮሙ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ዘከመ ፡ አስተርአዮ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ተውህበት ፡ ሎሙ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይትዔወራ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለመንግሥተ ፡ እስራኤል ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ይሁባ ፡ ለባዕዳን ፡ ለክብሮሙ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-went to those his-brothers, and-they-assembled together, and-he-told-them all how appeared-to-him angel-of God, and-how was-given to-them ark-of his-law of-God, and-how God (will) turn-away-from (?) the-kingdom-of Israel, and-how he-gives-it (fem.) to-strangers for-their-glory;
sentences.i: He went to those brothers of his and they gathered together, and he told them everything: how the angel of God had appeared to him; how the Ark of the law of God was given to them; how God will turn away from (?) the kingdom of Israel; and how he will give it to strangers for their glory;
sentences.n: ወተጋብኡ 'and they gathered' (ተጋብአ). አሐተኔ 'together, as one' (አሐቲ + enclitic ኔ, an adverbial 'at once, in unison'). ወነገሮሙ 'and he told them'. ዘከመ 'how' is repeated at the head of each clause: a list of what he reports. ተውህበት ሎሙ 'was given to them' (ተውህበ, the passive of ወሀበ). The crux is ይትዔወራ: it looks like ተዐወረ with a fem. object suffix, but a sense 'God will turn from / be blind to' is a guess (?). The -ኣ on ይትዔወራ and on ይሁባ is feminine, agreeing with መንግሥት 'kingdom' (ለመንግሥተ is the doubled object), so I take ይሁባ as 'he gives it (the kingdom) to strangers', not the Ark; the form alone does not exclude the Ark. ይሁባ 'he gives it' (ወሀበ + -ኣ). ለክብሮሙ 'for their glory'; ክብር 'glory', the word of the book's title.

sentences.t: ወዘከመ ፡ ንነሥኣ ፡ ንሕነ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ተሀይደት ፡ ኀቤነ ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወኢተርፈት ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኢዮርብዓም ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ፪ ፡ በትር ፡ ወዘከመ ፡ ትትከፈል ፡ መንግሥተ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: and-how we-take-her we, the-ark-of his-law of-God, and-how it-went-over (?) to-us the-kingdom-of Solomon and-not-it-remained with Jeroboam his-son except 2 rods, and-how it-will-be-divided the-kingdom-of Israel;
sentences.i: how we shall take the Ark of the law of God ourselves; how the kingdom of Solomon has passed over (?) to us and did not remain with Jeroboam, his son, except for two tribes; and how the kingdom of Israel will be divided.
sentences.n: ንነሥኣ ንሕነ 'we take her, we' (the independent pronoun gives stress). ተሀይደት 'passed over, was transferred' (?), a verb I do not know with confidence. ኢተርፈት 'it did not remain' (ተርፈ). ኢዮርብዓም ወልዱ 'Jeroboam, his son': the text has Jeroboam where the historical successor is Rehoboam (1 Kings 11-12), a mix-up in the source that I leave as written. ዘእንበለ ፪ በትር 'except two rods'; በትር 'staff' stands for 'tribe' (Judah and Benjamin, 1 Kings 12:20-21). ትትከፈል 'will be divided' (ተከፍለ, passive).

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ተፈሥሑ ፡ ሊተ ፡ እስመ ፡ አንሰ ፡ እትፌሣሕ ፡ በእንተ ፡ ዘአስተርአየኒ ፡ ከመዝ ፤
sentences.l: And-now rejoice for-me, for as-for-me I-rejoice because-of what appeared-to-me thus;
sentences.i: "So now, rejoice for me, for I am glad at what has thus been shown to me;
sentences.n: ወይእዜኒ 'and now' (ይእዜ + ኒ). ተፈሥሑ ሊተ 'rejoice for me!' (imperative plural of ተፈሥሐ; ሊተ 'to me' is the strong form). አንሰ 'as for me' (the ሰ marks contrast). እትፌሣሕ 'I rejoice'. ዘአስተርአየኒ 'what was shown to me' (the suffix -ኒ 'to me'). ከመዝ 'thus'. The speech now turns to the brothers: Azariah addresses the other three.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ ምስሌነ ፡ ትፈልስ ፡ ጸጋ ፡ ክህነቶሙ ፡ ወመንግሥቶሙ ፡ እስመ ፡ በፈቃደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይከውን ፡ ከመዝ ፡ ይቤለኒ ።
sentences.l: for with-us it-will-migrate the-grace-of their-priesthood and-their-kingdom, for by-the-will-of God it-will-be thus, he-said-to-me.
sentences.i: for the grace of their priesthood and their kingdom will migrate with us, since it will be so by God's will, he told me."
sentences.n: ትፈልስ 'it will migrate' (ፈለሰ, the verb of exile and moving; the same root as ያፈልሳ above). ጸጋ ክህነቶሙ ወመንግሥቶሙ 'the grace-of their priesthood and their kingdom', a construct chain; 'their' refers to Israel. በፈቃደ እግዚኣብሔር 'by the will-of God'. ይቤለኒ 'he said to me', the closing of the quotation.

sentences.t: ወይእዜኒ ፡ ንዑ ፡ ንሖር ፡ ወንንግሮ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይበሎ ፡ ለአቡሁ ፡ እሠውዕ ፨
sentences.l: And-now come, let-us-go and-let-us-tell David our-lord, that he-say-to his-father: Let-me-sacrifice.
sentences.i: Now come, let us go and tell David our lord, so that he may say to his father, 'Let me make the sacrifice.'
sentences.n: ንዑ 'come!' (plural of the defective imperative ንዓ, which serves as the imperative of መጽአ). ንሖር 'let us go' and ንንግሮ 'let us tell him' are jussives (1st plural). ለዳዊት እግዚእነ 'to David, our lord'. ከመ ይበሎ 'that he say to him'. እሠውዕ 'that I may sacrifice' (1st sing. subjunctive). The paragraph sign ፨ closes the speech.

sentences.t: ወሖሩ ፡ ወነገርዎ ፡ ወውእቱ ፡ ተፈሥሐ ፡ ወለአከ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ኢዮአስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዮዳሔ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይምጻእ ፡ ኀቤሁ ፡ ወይልአኮ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አቡሁ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-went and-they-told-him, and-he he-rejoiced, and-he-sent to Joash son-of Jehoiada that he-come to-him and-he-send-him to his-father;
sentences.i: They went and told him, and he rejoiced, and sent to Joash, son of Jehoiada, to come to him, so that he might send him to his father.
sentences.n: ወሖሩ 'and they went' (ሖረ). ወነገርዎ 'and they told him'. ወውእቱ ተፈሥሐ 'and he, he rejoiced' (ውእቱ resumes the subject). ወለአከ 'and he sent' (ለአከ), ኀበ ኢዮአስ 'to Joash'. ወልደ ዮዳሔ 'son-of Jehoiada' (a construct); Joash is named here in the Hebrew form (ch. 45 has ዮአስ 'Joas'); the text does not say what his rank is. ይልአኮ 'he would send him' (ለአከ + -ሁ).

sentences.t: ወመጽአ ፡ ወለአኮ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ ኀበ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወይቤሎ ፡ ፈንወኒአ ፡ እሖር ፡ ውስተ ፡ ብሔርየ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ዘአሠነይከ ፡ ሊተ ፡ ወጸሎትከ ፡ ትትልወኒ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ሖርኩ ፡ በኵሉ ፡ ጊዜ ።
sentences.l: And-he-came and-he-sent-him David to his-father Solomon, and-he-said-to-him: Send-me (?), I-go to my-country, for-all that you-did-good for-me, and-your-prayer let-it-follow-me where I-go at-all time.
sentences.i: Joash came, and David sent him to his father Solomon, and he said to him: "Send me away, and I will go to my own country, for all the good you have done me; and may your prayer follow me wherever I go, at all times.
sentences.n: The messenger Joash carries David's message, so ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him' is David speaking through him; whom 'to him' is (Joash or Solomon) is not stated (?), and I take the words as David's message for Solomon. ፈንወኒ 'send me!' (imperative of ፈነወ + -ኒ). Stray አ attached to words in this speech (ፈንወኒአ, then in the next units ይእዜኒአ, እስእልአ, etc.) is in the source as given; probably a mark of Bezold's text, whose purpose I cannot tell (?). I read through it. ብሔርየ 'my country'. በኵሉ ዘአሠነይከ ሊተ 'for all that you did well to me' (አሠነየ 'do good'). ወጸሎትከ ትትልወኒ 'and may your prayer follow me' (ተልወ 'follow'; ትትልወኒ is 3rd fem. imperfect/jussive). ኀበ ሖርኩ 'where I have gone/ go'. በኵሉ ጊዜ 'at every time'.

sentences.t: ወባሕቱአ ፡ ይእዜኒአ ፡ እስእልአ ፡ በኀቤከአ ፡ ስእለተአ ፡ አሐተአ ፡ ለእመአ ፡ ረከብኩአ ፡ ሞገሰአ ፡ በኀቤከአ ፡ ወኢትሚጥአ ፡ ገጸከአ ፡ እምኔየአ ፤
sentences.l: And-but now-also I-ask of-you request one: if I-found favour with-you, and-not turn your-face from-me;
sentences.i: But now I also ask one favour of you: if I have found grace with you, do not turn your face from me;
sentences.n: ወባሕቱ 'but'. ስእለተ አሐተ 'one request' (accusative). ለእመ ረከብኩ ሞገሰ 'if I have found favour' (ሞገስ 'grace, favour'; the idiom of Genesis 18:3 and Ruth 2:2, 'to find grace in the eyes of'). ኢትሚጥ ገጸከ 'do not turn your face' (ሜጠ 'turn', negative jussive). እምኔየ 'from me'. Stray አ again, ignored.

sentences.t: እስመ ፡ አነአ ፡ ገብርከአ ፡ አሐውርአ ፡ ወእፈቅድአ ፡ እሡዕአ ፡ መሥዋዕተአ ፡ መድኀኒትአበእንተ ፡ ኀጢአትየአ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ዛቲ ፡ ሀገርአ ፡ ቅድስትአ ፡ ኢየሩሳሌምአ ፡ ወጽዮንአ ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉአ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔርአ ፤
sentences.l: for I your-servant I-go, and-I-wish to-sacrifice sacrifice-of salvation for my-sin in this city holy Jerusalem, and-Zion, ark-of his-law of-God;
sentences.i: for I am your servant, I am going, and I wish to offer a sacrifice of salvation for my sin in this holy city of Jerusalem, and Zion, the Ark of the law of God;
sentences.n: አነ ገብርከ 'I, your servant'. አሐውር 'I go' (ሖረ). እፈቅድ እሡዕ 'I wish to sacrifice' (two imperfects in a row, the second a subjunctive). መሥዋዕተ መድኀኒት 'sacrifice-of salvation', a construct; this sits as a glued word መድኀኒትአበእንተ, with the stray አ swallowing the wordspace before በእንተ 'for the sake of'. ዛቲ ሀገር ቅድስት 'this city, holy'. The last words repeat the phrase of the earlier speech.

sentences.t: ወሰላም ፡ ለዕዘዝከ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-peace to-your-dear-one (?).
sentences.i: And peace to your dear one (?)."
sentences.n: ወሰላም 'and peace', the closing greeting of a message. ለዕዘዝከ is unclear to me (?): perhaps ዕዙዝ 'dear, precious', here 'to your dear one'; I am not sure of the stem or whether it is a title. The string of ፨ is Bezold's closing ornament for the chapter.

sentences.t: ፵፯ ፡ በእንተ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ወንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: 47. Concerning the-sacrifice-of Azariah and-king.
sentences.i: Chapter 47: Concerning the sacrifice of Azariah and of the king.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. መሥዋዕተ 'sacrifice-of' is in the construct state before the name; 'of Azariah and of the king' is the chain's two genitives, the second joined by ወ-. ንጉሥ 'king' is without ለ- since it is in a chain.

sentences.t: ወሖረ ፡ ኢዮአስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ዮዳሔ ፡ ወነገሮ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ወተፈሥሐ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ወአዘዘ ፡ ከመ ፡ ያስተዳልዉ ፡ መሣውዐ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሡዕ ፡ ወልዱ ፤
sentences.l: And-he-went Joash son-of Jehoiada and-he-told-him, to-king Solomon, and-he-rejoiced king because-of-this, and-he-commanded that they-prepare place-of-sacrifice (?) sacrifice, that he-sacrifice his-son;
sentences.i: Joash, son of Jehoiada, went and told King Solomon, and the king rejoiced at this and ordered them to prepare a place of sacrifice and an offering, so that his son might sacrifice;
sentences.n: ወነገሮ ለንጉሥ ሰሎሞን 'and he told King Solomon' (the suffix -ሁ 'to him' is doubled by ለንጉሥ, as in the published entry). በእንተዝ 'on this account' (በእንተ + ዝ). ወአዘዘ ከመ ያስተዳልዉ 'and he commanded that they prepare' (the Ct-stem አስተዳለወ 'make ready'). መሣውዐ 'place of sacrifice' (a noun of place from ሠውዐ; compare ምሥዋዕ 'altar') and መሥዋዕተ 'offering' are juxtaposed; I read them as two objects (?). ከመ ይሡዕ ወልዱ 'that his son sacrifice'.

sentences.t: ወአምጽአ ፡ ወወሀቦ ፡ ዘይበፅዕ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ፻ ፡ አስዋረ ፡ ወ፻ ፡ መግዝአ ፡ ላህም ፡ ወ፼ ፡ አባግዕ ፡ ወ፼ ፡ አጣሊ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ ዘይትበላዕ ፡ አራዊት ፡ በበ፲ ፡ ወእምነ ፡ አዕዋፍ ፡ ዘንጹሕ ፡ በበ ፡ ፲ ፡ በዘያወጽሕ ፡ ወይሠውዕ ፡ ለአምላከ ፡ እስራኤል ፤
sentences.l: And-he-brought and-he-gave-him what befits for-God: 100 bulls (?) and-100 oxen (?) of-cattle, and-10,000 sheep and-10,000 kids (?), and-of those which are-eaten of-wild-animals ten-each, and-of birds which clean ten-each, by-what he-brings-out and-sacrifices to-the-God-of Israel;
sentences.i: He brought and gave him what is fitting for God: a hundred bulls (?), a hundred oxen (?) of the herd, ten thousand sheep and ten thousand kids (?), and ten each of the edible wild animals and ten each of the clean birds, of whatever he would bring out and sacrifice to the God of Israel (?);
sentences.n: ወአምጽአ ወወሀቦ 'and he brought and gave him' (the king is the subject). ዘይበፅዕ 'what befits' (perhaps a form of በጽሐ 'reach, belong to' (?); the text has ፅ). Numbers are words in this text: ፻ is 100 (spoken ምእት 'məʾət'), ፼ is 10,000 (spoken ትእልፍት (?) 'təʾəlfət'); ፲ is 10. አስዋረ 'bulls' (plural of ሰዋር? form uncertain (?)); መግዝአ ላህም 'oxen (?) of the herd': መግዝእ is not known to me (?), perhaps 'leader of the herd'. አባግዕ 'sheep', አጣሊ 'kids' (?). ዘይትበላዕ አራዊት 'of the wild animals that are eaten' (a passive relative). በበ፲ 'ten of each'. ዘንጹሕ 'which is clean' (Leviticus 11 distinctions). በዘያወጽሕ 'by what he brings out' (?): two imperfects, ያወጽሕ ወይሠውዕ, so a relative 'whatever he brings out and sacrifices', not a purpose clause. ለአምላከ እስራኤል 'to the God-of Israel'.

sentences.t: ወመሥዋዕተ ፡ ስንዳሌኒ ፡ ፳ ፡ ጻሕለ ፡ ዘብሩር ፡ ለለ ፡ አሐቲ ፡ ዘበበ ፡ ፲ወ፪ ፡ ድልወተ ፡ ሰቅሎን ፡ ወ፵ ፡ መዛርአ ፡ ኀባውዝ ፤
sentences.l: And-offering-of fine-flour-also 20 dishes of-silver, for-each one with each 12 weights-of shekels, and-40 vessels (?) ḫäbawz (?);
sentences.i: and a grain offering of fine flour: twenty silver dishes, each weighing twelve shekels, and forty vessels (?) of ḫäbawz (meaning unknown);
sentences.n: ስንዳሌኒ 'fine flour also' (ስንዳሌ + ኒ); the grain-offering as in Leviticus 2:1. ጻሕል 'dish, platter', ዘብሩር 'of silver'. ለለ አሐቲ ዘበበ ፲ወ፪ 'for each one, at twelve each': ፲ወ፪ is 'ten and two' (spoken ዐሠርቱ ወክልኤቱ). ድልወተ ሰቅሎን 'a weighing of shekels' (?); ድልው 'ready, balanced'. መዛርእ is 'vessels for scattering / sprinkling' (?) from ዘረወ; ኀባውዝ I cannot read (?), perhaps a material or measure; flagged for the glosser.

sentences.t: ወዘንተ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ ወሀቦ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ወልዱ ፡ ሰሎሞን ፡ ንጉሥ ።
sentences.l: And-this all he-gave to-David his-son Solomon king.
sentences.i: All this King Solomon gave to David, his son.
sentences.n: ወዘንተ ኵሎ 'and all this' (ዘንተ, the accusative of ዝ). Order is: verb, then the recipient, then the subject: ወሀቦ ለዳዊት ወልዱ ሰሎሞን ንጉሥ, 'gave-it to David, his son, Solomon, the king': Solomon is the giver.

sentences.t: ወካዕበ ፡ ለአከ ፡ እንዘ ፡ ይብል ፡ ይሡዕአ ፡ ሊተ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ወልደ ፡ ካህን ፡ ህየንቴየ ፤
sentences.l: And-again he-sent saying: Let-him-sacrifice for-me Azariah son-of priest in-my-place;
sentences.i: Again David sent, saying: "Let Azariah, a priest's son, sacrifice for me in my place."
sentences.n: ወካዕበ ለአከ 'and again he sent', እንዘ ይብል 'saying' (እንዘ + imperfect of ይቤ 'say'). ይሡዕ 'let him sacrifice', with a stray አ in the source. ህየንቴየ 'in my stead' (ህየንተ + -የ). ወልደ ካህን 'a priest's son', as in unit 4.

sentences.t: ወይቤሎ ፡ ግበርአ ፡ ዘፈቀድከ ።
sentences.l: And-he-said-to-him: do what you-wished.
sentences.i: And Solomon said to him: "Do as you wish."
sentences.n: ግበር 'do!' (stray አ in the source) ዘፈቀድከ 'what you wished' (ፈቀደ, relative ዘ). The 'him' is the messenger.

sentences.t: ወተፈሥሐ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ በእንተዝ ፡ ነገር ፡ ወሖረ ፡ ወአምጽአ ፡ እመራዕየ ፡ አቡሁ ፡ አሐተ ፡ ላህመ ፡ እንተ ፡ ኢሰሐበት ፡ አርዑተ ፡ ወ፬ ፡ ጠሊተ ፡ ዘዘ ፡ ዓመት ፡ ወ፬ ፡ በግዐ ፡ ንጹሓን ፡ ዘዘ ፡ ዓመት ።
sentences.l: And-he-rejoiced Azariah because-of-this word, and-he-went and-he-brought from-the-pastures-of his-father one cow which not she-drew yokes, and-4 lambs (?) each-year and-4 sheep pure each-year.
sentences.i: Azariah was glad at this word. He went and brought from his father's pastures one cow that had never drawn a yoke, four lambs (?), and four pure sheep, each a year old.
sentences.n: በእንተዝ ነገር 'because of this word/matter'. እመራዕየ አቡሁ 'from the pastures of his father' (መራዕይ 'pasture', አቡሁ 'his father'). The list echoes the angel's command in ch. 46 exactly (ላህመ እንተ ኢሰሐበት አርዑተ; ጠሊተ; ንጹሓን), so he does as he was told. ዘዘ ዓመት is spaced here as two words but is 'each year', i.e. yearlings. ንጹሓን 'pure ones' (plural, of ንጹሕ).

sentences.t: ወሖረ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ከመ ፡ ይሡዕ ፡ ወተደለዉ ፡ ካህናት ፡ ወተጋብኡ ፡ ነዳያን ፡ ወተፈሥሐ ፡ አዕዋፈ ፡ ሰማይ ፡ ወኀብሩ ፡ ፍሥሓ ፡ ዐቢየ ፡ በይእቲ ፡ ዕለት ።
sentences.l: And-he-went king to-sacrifice, and-were-prepared priests, and-were-gathered poor, and-rejoiced birds-of heaven, and-they-united (?) joy great on-that day.
sentences.i: The king went to sacrifice; the priests were made ready, the poor gathered, the birds of the heavens rejoiced, and on that day they joined together in great joy (?).
sentences.n: ተደለዉ 'were made ready' (ተደለወ). ነዳያን 'poor ones'. አዕዋፈ ሰማይ 'birds-of heaven' (a construct, the phrase of Genesis 1:26 and Psalm 8:8). ኀብሩ ፍሥሓ ዐቢየ 'they united in great joy' (ኀብረ 'join, be united', as in the published entry, not 'make'; the exact sense with ፍሥሓ is uncertain (?)). በይእቲ ዕለት 'on that day'.

sentences.t: ወአዛርያስኒ ፡ ደመረ ፡ ምስለ ፡ መሥዋዕተ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ወሦዐ ፡ ንዋዮ ፡ በከመ ፡ አዘዞ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለአዛርያስ ፡ በሌሊት ።
sentences.l: And-Azariah-also added with the-offering-of king and-sacrificed his-goods, as he-commanded-him angel-of God to-Azariah by-night.
sentences.i: Azariah also added his own to the king's offering and sacrificed his goods, as the angel of God had commanded him in the night.
sentences.n: ወአዛርያስኒ 'and Azariah too' (ኒ enclitic). ደመረ ምስለ 'he joined/ added (his) with'. ሦዐ ንዋዮ 'he sacrificed his goods' (ንዋይ 'vessel, property, goods', here the beasts brought; (?)). በከመ አዘዞ 'as he commanded him'. በሌሊት 'by night', the dream of ch. 46.

sentences.t: ወእምዝ ፡ እምድኅረ ፡ ሦዑ ፡ ገብኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ አብያቲሆሙ ፡ ወኖሙ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-then after they-sacrificed they-returned to their-houses and-they-slept.
sentences.i: Then, after they had sacrificed, they went home and slept.
sentences.n: ወእምዝ እምድኅረ 'and then, after' (እምዝ 'thereafter'). ሦዑ 'they sacrificed' (3rd plural perfect of ሠውዐ). ገብኡ ውስተ አብያቲሆሙ 'they returned to their houses' (አብያት plural of ቤት 'house'). ወኖሙ 'and they slept' (ኖመ). The ፨ ፨ closes the chapter.

sentences.t: ፵፰ ፡ ኀበ ፡ አንሥእዋ ፡ ለጽዮን ።
sentences.l: 48. Where they-raised Zion.
sentences.i: Chapter 48: Where they lifted Zion.
sentences.n: Chapter heading. ኀበ 'where, to the place where'; አንሥእዋ 'they raised her' (አንሥአ 'raise up', the causative of the root n-ś-ʾ (ነሥአ 'take', ተንሥአ 'rise'), plus the 3rd fem. suffix -ኣ), with ለጽዮን as the marked object 'Zion'. The title gestures at the removal of the Ark.

sentences.t: ወናሁ ፡ ካዕበ ፡ አስተርአዮ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ለአዛርያስ ፡ ወሠረቀ ፡ ላዕሌሁ ፡ ከመ ፡ ዐምደ ፡ እሳት ፡ ወመልአ ፡ ቤት ፡ በብርሃኑ ፡ ወአንሥኦ ፡ ለአዛርያስ ፡ ወይቤሎ ፤
sentences.l: And-behold again appeared-to-him angel-of God to-Azariah, and-he-shone above-him like pillar-of fire, and-filled the-house with-his-light, and-he-raised Azariah and-said-to-him;
sentences.i: And behold, again the angel of God appeared to Azariah, shone above him like a pillar of fire, filled the house with his light, raised Azariah up, and said to him:
sentences.n: ወናሁ 'and behold' (ናሁ). ሠረቀ ላዕሌሁ 'he shone above him' (ሠረቀ is said of sun and stars). ዐምደ እሳት 'a pillar-of fire', the pillar of Exodus 13:21 that led Israel. መልአ ቤት በብርሃኑ 'he filled the house with his light'. አንሥኦ 'he raised him' (አንሥአ + -ሁ). ወይቤሎ 'and he said to him' closes at ፤, the speech follows.

sentences.t: ቁም ፡ ወጽናዕ ፡ ወአንቅሆ ፡ ለኤልምያኖስ ፡ እኁከ ፡ ለአብሳ ፡ ወለማከሪ ፡ ወንሥኡ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ ዕፀወ ፡ አልዋሕ ፡ ወአነ ፡ አርኁ ፡ ለከ ፡ አናቅጺሃ ፡ ለቤተ ፡ መቅደስ ፡ ወንሥኣ ፡ ለታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወትወስዳ ፡ ዘእንበለ ፡ ደዌ ፡ ወሕማም ፡ ወአነሂ ፡ እስመ ፡ ተአዘዝኩ ፡ እምኀበ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ከመ ፡ አሀሉ ፡ ዘልፈ ፡ ምስሌሃ ፡ ወእኩንከ ፡ መርሐ ፡ በነሢኦታ ።
sentences.l: Stand and-be-strong, and-wake-him to-Elmeyanos your-brother, to-Abisa and-to-Makari, and-take (pl.) they wood-of boards (?), and-I I-will-open for-you its-doors for-the-house-of sanctuary, and-take-her the-ark-of his-law of-God, and-you-carry-her without sickness and-pain; and-I-also since I-was-commanded from God that I-be always with-her, and-I-be to-you guide in-her-taking.
sentences.i: "Stand up and be strong, and wake Elmeyanos, your brother, and Abisa and Makari, and let them take (?) planks of wood; and I will open the doors of the sanctuary for you, and take the Ark of the law of God, and you shall carry her without sickness or pain. And I, since I have been commanded by God to be with her always, will be your guide in taking her."
sentences.n: ቁም ወጽናዕ 'stand and be strong' (imperatives of ቆመ and ጸንዐ). አንቅሆ 'wake him!' (2nd masc. sing. imperative of አንቅሀ, the causative of ነቅሀ, + -ኦ; the object is doubled by the names). ለኤልምያኖስ እኁከ 'Elmeyanos, your brother', the ለ- marks the object. ወንሥኡ እሙንቱ: ንሥኡ is the 2nd masc. plural imperative 'take!', here with እሙንቱ 'they, those', so perhaps 'let those take' (?); ወንሥኣ below is the 2nd masc. singular imperative ንሣእ + -ኣ 'take her!'. ዕፀወ አልዋሕ 'wood-of boards' (ዕፀው plural of ዕፅ; አልዋሕ 'boards' with the singular uncertain (?), as in the published ch. 45), the planks for the copy of the Ark. አርኁ 'I shall open' (አርኅወ, the causative of ርኅወ 'be open'; 1st sing. subjunctive), አናቅጺሃ 'its gates' (አናቅጽ 'gates', with the suffix -ሃ), ለቤተ መቅደስ 'of the house of the sanctuary'. ወትወስዳ 'you will take her' (ወሰደ). ዘእንበለ ደዌ ወሕማም 'without sickness and pain' (perhaps recalling the plague on the Ark's captors, 1 Samuel 5-6, and 2 Samuel 6:7 (?)). ወአነሂ 'and I also'. ተአዘዝኩ 'I was commanded'. ከመ አሀሉ 'that I be' (ሀለወ). ዘልፈ 'always'. ወእኩንከ መርሐ 'and I shall be to you a guide' (መርሕ 'leader', accusative). በነሢኦታ 'in the taking of her' (the verbal noun ነሢኦት + -ሃ).

sentences.t: ወተንሥአ ፡ ሶቤሃ ፡ ወአንቅሆሙ ፡ ለሠለስቲሆሙ ፡ አኀዊሁ ፡ ወነሥኡ ፡ እሙንቱ ፡ አልዋሐ ፡ ወሖሩ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፤
sentences.l: And-he-arose at-once and-woke-them the-three-of-them his-brothers, and-they-took those boards and-they-went to house-of God;
sentences.i: He rose at once and woke his three brothers, and they took the planks and went to the house of God;
sentences.n: ሶቤሃ 'at once, immediately'. ወአንቅሆሙ 'and he woke them' (አንቀሀ + -ሙ). ለሠለስቲሆሙ አኀዊሁ 'the three of them, his brothers' (ሠለስቲሆሙ is ሠለስቱ with a suffix, 'their three'). አልዋሐ 'boards' as the object. ቤተ እግዚኣብሔር 'house-of God', the Temple.

sentences.t: ወረከቡ ፡ ርኅወ ፡ ኵሎ ፡ አናቅጸ ፡ እምአፍአ ፡ እስከ ፡ ውሥጥ ፡ ርኅዋተ ፡ አናቅጸ ፡ እስከ ፡ ውእደ ፡ ይበጽሕ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ጽዮን ፡ ታቦተ ፡ ሕጉ ፡ ለእግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወተንሥአት ፡ ሶቤሃ ፡ ከመ ፡ ቅጽበተ ፡ ዐይን ፡ እስመ ፡ መልአከ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ይሜግባ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-found opened all the-doors from-outside to inside, doors opened until (?) it-reaches to Zion, ark-of his-law of-God, and-she-arose at-once like blink-of eye, for angel-of God was-moving-her (?);
sentences.i: They found all the doors open, from outside to inside, open until (?) one reaches Zion, the Ark of the law of God; and she rose at once, in the blink of an eye, for the angel of God was moving her (?).
sentences.n: ወረከቡ ርኅወ ኵሎ አናቅጸ 'they found all the gates open' (ርኅው 'open', adjective, accusative). እምአፍአ እስከ ውሥጥ 'from outside to inside'. ርኅዋተ አናቅጸ 'the opened gates' repeats the fact. እስከ ውእደ ይበጽሕ 'until it reaches' with ውእደ (?), a word I cannot read, perhaps 'as far as the reach of one's hand' or a scribal fault; the sense 'right up to Zion' is clear. ተንሥአት 'she rose' (fem.: the Ark). ከመ ቅጽበተ ዐይን 'like the blink of an eye' (compare 1 Corinthians 15:52). ይሜግባ is unknown to me (?); I read 'he moves / carries her' from context.

sentences.t: ወሶበሰ ፡ ኢፈቀደ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ እመ ፡ ኢተንሥአት ፡ ሶቤሃ ።
sentences.l: And-if not he-willed God — if not she-arose at-once.
sentences.i: And had God not willed it, she would not have risen at once.
sentences.n: ወሶበሰ ኢፈቀደ እግዚኣብሔር 'and whereas God did not will' (the ሰ gives contrast: the miracle is God's). እመ ኢተንሥአት ሶቤሃ 'she would not have risen at once' (እመ is 'if'; a second conditional after ወሶበሰ is odd (?), and I read the whole as an unreal condition, 'had God not willed, she would not have risen'). Stated as a pious reservation: the Ark is not lifted by the men.

sentences.t: ወነሥእዋ ፡ አርባዕቲሆሙ ፡ ወአእተውዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ አዛርያስ ፡ ወገብኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤተ ፡ እግዚኣብሔር ፡ ወአስተላጸቁ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምንባሪሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወከደንዎን ፡ ለዕፀው ፡ በአልባሲሃ ፡ ለጽዮን ፡ ወዐጸዉ ፡ አናቅጸ ፤
sentences.l: And-they-took-her the-four-of-them, and-they-brought-her into house-of Azariah, and-they-returned to house-of God, and-they-made-cling (?) in her-place-of-setting of-Zion, and-they-covered-them (the woods) with-her-garments of-Zion, and-they-shut gates;
sentences.i: The four of them took her and brought her into the house of Azariah, then returned to the house of God, fitted the planks (?) into the place of Zion, covered the wood with the garments of Zion, and shut the gates.
sentences.n: ወነሥእዋ አርባዕቲሆሙ 'and the four of them took her' (አርባዕቲሆሙ 'their four'). ወአእተውዋ 'and they brought her in' (አእተወ, 'bring in' (?)). Note she is taken out of the Temple to Azariah's house and then they go back to the Temple, carrying the planks. ወአስተላጸቁ 'and they fitted/ made cling' (?) the planks. ውስተ ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'into her seat, of Zion' (ምንባር 'seat, place of sitting'). ወከደንዎን ለዕፀው 'and they covered them, the timbers' (ከደነ 'cover', -ን fem./pl. suffix). በአልባሲሃ ለጽዮን 'with her garments, of Zion's'. ወዐጸዉ አናቅጸ 'and they closed the gates' (ዐጸወ). This is the substitution of the copy planned in ch. 45.

sentences.t: ወገብኡ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ቤቶሙ ፡ ወነሥኡ ፡ መኃትወ ፡ ወአንበርዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምኅባኢሃ ፡ ወሦዑ ፡ ላቲ ፡ በግዐ ፡ ወአጸንሕሑ ፡ ስኂነ ፡ ወነጸፉ ፡ ላቲ ፡ ሜላተ ፡ ወአንበርዋ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ምስዋር ፡ ፯ ፡ ዕለተ ፡ ወ፯ ፡ ሌሊተ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨ ፨
sentences.l: And-they-returned to their-houses and-they-took a-vessel-or-tool (?) and-they-set-her in her-hiding-place, and-they-sacrificed for-her sheep and-they-made-fragrant incense (?), and-they-spread for-her a-cloth (?), and-they-set-her in hiding-place (?) 7 days and-7 nights.
sentences.i: They went back to their houses and took an implement or vessel (?), and set her in her hiding place; they sacrificed a sheep for her, made fragrant (?) a spice or incense (?), spread a cloth (?) for her, and set her in a place of concealment (?) for seven days and seven nights.
sentences.n: ወነሥኡ መኃትወ 'and they took a መኃትው', an implement or vessel I cannot identify (?) (the published entry says only 'perhaps for sealing'); I have no ground for 'chest'. ወአንበርዋ 'and they set her down' (አንበረ + -ኣ). ምኅባኢሃ 'her hiding-place' (ምኅባእ from ኀብአ 'hide'). ወሦዑ ላቲ በግዐ 'and they sacrificed a sheep for her'. ወአጸንሕሑ ስኂነ 'and they perfumed (?) a spice/ incense (?)': ጸንሐ is 'be fragrant' (?); ስኂን is unknown to me (?). ወነጸፉ ላቲ ሜላተ 'and they spread for her a cloth' (ነጸፈ; ሜላት an obscure word for something spread (?), 'cloth' being a guess). ምስዋር 'hiding-place' I read from ሰወረ 'conceal' (?); it might also be a form of 'altar', ምሥዋዕ. ፯ ዕለተ ወ፯ ሌሊተ 'seven days and seven nights' (the numeral ፯, spoken ሰብዐቱ 'säbʿätu'; accusative of time). The ፨ run is Bezold's closing ornament.
